## About

The **Hedge Vertical Index (HVI)** is a composite LiDAR structure index for the holistic
description, habitat classification and species-specific assessment of hedgerows. Raw
per-segment metrics (LAD profile, foliage-height diversity, vertical-complexity index,
layer occupancy, gappiness, height, horizontal heterogeneity) feed a composite index with
PCA-derived weights, fuzzy suitability curves and habitat clustering. The dashboard below
runs the index on four idealised synthetic hedge structures; the full pipeline (`lidR` /
`sf` / `terra`) is designed to run on real airborne-laser-scanning point clouds and hedge
polygons, with species response curves calibrated against field occurrence data.
